Protein pellets from HEK293 cells were resuspended in 4 M urea, which was then digested overnight at room temperature with Lys-C (1:200 enzyme to protein ratio) followed by dilution to 1.5M urea and 4 hour digestion with trypsin (1:200 enzyme to protein ratio).
Normalized collision energies were set to 35% with an activation time of 2 ms for the MS2 method. ... Normalized collision energies were set to 25%.

followed by alkylation with 10 mM iodoacetamide for 30 minutes at room temperature in the dark.
